The '''Agronomy Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked in the {{LI|Wheat}} collection at {{coll|Wheat 2}}, {{coll|Wheat 5}}, {{coll|Wheat 8}}, {{coll|Wheat 10}}, and {{Coll|Wheat 11}} with increasing capacity. The Small Agronomy Sack can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, the Medium Agronomy Sack can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and the Large Agronomy Sack can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item. Beginner Sack holds {{Green|640}} items, but only includes vanilla resources. The Large Enchanted Agronomy Sack can hold {{Green|20,160}} of enchanted items.

== Obtaining ==
=== Merchant ===
A '''Beginner Agronomy Sack''' can be bought for {{c|250}} at {{NPCSprite|Farm Merchant}} in the [[Hub]] near the {{Zone|Farm}}.

== Bugs ==
* {{Item|Cropie}}, {{Item|Squash}} and {{Item|Compost}} stored inside the {{Item|Garden Sack}} will incorrectly appear in the '''Agronomy Sack''', despite the tooltip displaying that "{{Mctxt|c|This item has been removed from this sack! After withdrawal it can no longer be deposited into this sack.}}"

== Trivia ==
*[[File:Personal Compactor 4000.png|24px]] [[Personal Compactor (disambiguation)|Personal Compactors]] will not automatically compact items inside the sack until the items are out of the sack.
